GENUINE ENGINE GAP, checked and confirmed, NOT closed by this task (same conclusion The Prima Vista's own migration already reached, re-verified independently for this card rather than assumed to transfer): 'if at least four mana was spent to cast it' has NO tracking mechanism anywhere in this engine — grepped functional-model/*.ts for manaSpent/spentMana/totalManaSpent/'mana spent': zero hits; checked StackObject/EffectContext/RealCard for any 'amount actually paid' field: none exists (payMana only returns which RealCard sources were tapped, never a total). This is untouched by today's real cost-REDUCTION closures (CostReduction/ActivationCostReduction/SpellCostReductionGrant, effectiveCastCost/effectiveActivationCost) — those compute what's OWED before payment, they don't record what was actually SPENT paying it; a structurally different, still-fully-open gap. The trigger firing at all (via `sequence`) stands in for the condition having been met, same convention every other conditional trigger in this pool uses (Namazu Trader's own 'if you do', Minwu's own onLifeGained, e.g.).
